summary.title: Trade idea: Fred VanVleet for VJ Edgecombe + Jusuf Nurkić (jesse's Phenomenal Team)
summary.headline: 1-for-2 with jesse's Phenomenal Team (slot 5): we give VanVleet, get Edgecombe + Nurkić (Out), then drop Nurkić and keep the open spot for a free agent.
summary.verdict:
Worth proposing if you're open to moving VanVleet: helps playoff odds, title odds and category wins under all three projection sets.
The partner's own playoff odds dip slightly (−0.3 to −2.5 pp), so expect a counter; Dyson Daniels + Nurkić is a similar alternative.
Needs your explicit yes before anything is offered on Yahoo.
rationale: Fred VanVleet is a 32-year-old point guard (Houston) projected for ~58 games; VJ Edgecombe is a young guard (Philadelphia, PG/SG) projected to play more and contribute steals, threes and rebounds.
Taking Nurkić (currently Out) and dropping him gives us an extra open roster spot that we refill from free agency, which is where part of the gain comes from.

Simulated effect (5 fresh seeds, base already includes the Champagnie claim): title odds +3.9 / +3.7 / +2.5 pp, playoff odds +0.9 / +1.3 / +1.1 pp, +0.5 to +0.8 category wins per season (blend / market / ESPN stress).
- Not mainly a schedule bet: Edgecombe's Philadelphia plays 4/3/4 games in playoff weeks 18-20 vs VanVleet's Houston 4/3/3 (one extra game).
- Costs the model doesn't see: one add to refill, and Edgecombe is a second-year player whose role could change.

why_now.before: Trades weren't possible before the draft, and last night's scan focused on Jamal Murray; it didn't evaluate this partner specifically.

changed.text: There is now a willing partner who has asked about VanVleet (observed by Muse; details private).
A targeted inseason-0.3.0 scan of this partner's roster (base incl. Champagnie/Bailey, realistic refill, 5 fresh seeds, 3 projection sets) found this counter helps under all three.

risks: ± are Monte Carlo SEs only; the simulator is optimistic for us (opponents never manage rosters).
Partner may counter; any counter gets re-evaluated before you decide.
Trades go through a 2-day commissioner review.
